source_quote: Iroh: Fire is the element of power. [drive/ambition from Iroh's speech in the animated episode 'Bitter Work' (2006), NOT verified online: wiki blocked]
Iroh: Water is the element of change ... the people of the Water Tribes transform adversity into growth. [community from the animated speech, not verified]
Iroh: The people of the Earth Kingdom are resilient and enduring, like the hills around us.
Iroh: Air is the element of freedom ... the Air Nomads live freely of worldly possessions and find peace through detachment and lightness.
